ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) base with high-intensity (white) linear and point-source anomalies; approximate 85:15 dark-to-light ratio across the visible ventral plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Single contiguous dark (low-intensity) geometric region forming the fluke surface, overlaid with a dense, chaotic network of high-intensity (white) linear vectors and localized clusters of high-intensity pixels at the distal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 35 degrees; depth is vertically aligned and clearly separates the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; significant macro-scale jagged discontinuities (peaks and valleys) observed on the distal half of the left lobe and the central-to-distal section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct upward-outward sweep; leading edges exhibit smooth convex curves while the trailing edges follow an overall concave arc heavily disrupted by irregular serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters detected at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered circular point-source anomalies (3-8 pixels in diameter) visible across the dark interior surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, high-intensity (white) linear pixel disruptions; numerous parallel groupings (3-5 lines per set) detected, particularly on the medial and lateral surfaces of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular contour deformities and jagged tissue-loss patterns on the trailing edges; extensive rake-mark scarring across approximately 60% of the visible surface area.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly localized cluster of white pixels forming a complex geometric shape at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe, appearing distinct from linear rake marks.
